name: Sweatshop Simulator
detailed_description:
Get ready to build and manage your own... "entrepreneurial" venture from the ground up! In Sweatshop Simulator, you will take on the challenge of creating a thriving business, navigating the ups and downs of resource management, and, of course, "motivating" your workers to get the job done.

  • Build and customize your operation from scratch, optimizing production and resource allocation to maximize profits.

  • Command your workers, each with their own strengths and weaknesses, to execute tasks and keep your business running smoothly.

  • Balance risk and reward as you navigate the... "gray areas" of the business world.

  • Adapt to the dynamically changing stock market

  • As you progress, unlock new equipment, upgrades, and "specialized" products to expand your operation and increase profits.

  • But beware: with great power comes great hostility... and unwanted attention. Be prepared to hustle and bargain your way out of police raids.

Will you rise to the top, or get caught in the act?

Sweatshop Simulator is a game of strategy, wit, and a dash of humor. Can you navigate the cutthroat world of underground entrepreneurship and come out on top?

Will you build your empire Alone or with Friends?

Play the original single-player experience, or play with up to three friends in Online co-op!

Build, Box, Adapt!

As your production line increases new legal and not-so-legal opportunities will be made available and with every piece of product sold the market value will change according to demand. Adding an extra layer of business strategy to the production of your goods.

Expand your Empire

As your "business" grows, new items and workers will become available to you. As well as bigger and better locations. Starting from Mom's garage to sketchy basements, all the way to Huge Warehouses!

short_description: Build a lucrative business from the ground up, navigating the gray areas of the entrepreneurial world. Manage resources, hire workers, and balance risk and reward in a game of strategy and business sense. A simulator that has you take on the role of a business owner who will do whatever it takes.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10, 11
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-4590
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

content_descriptors.notes: Whilst playing the game, the player will receive options to buy, sell, and distribute illegal items such as legal and illegal drugs, firearms, other random items such as toys and clothing. A main focus of the gameplay is to run and manage a sweatshop in which the player's "workers" can be treated under poor conditions, there are also options to employ children implied to be under the legal working age. The player will also encounter the ability to bribe police officers.
